findings.title: Same-version shared signed RPM bootstrap is not guaranteed by two first-generation pipelines
evidence: compose-package-site.py:1746-1787 requires matching newly signed receipt entries
sign-package-family.py:707-719 invokes rpmsign without deterministic signing time
findings.requested_resolution: Use separate TEST ONLY bootstrap versions sharing public keys and repository config, or demonstrate an existing supported sign-once reuse path without producer changes.

implementation_clarification: State where real gpg/rpm tools used by make_composite_plan are available to Python/Docker coordinator; clients must not receive Docker socket.
